findings.description: For throwables no inbound use packet and no guard/trace line is logged (PacketWitness records only ServerboundUseItemOnPacket, and the Item.use trace does not fire for the overriding SnowballItem/EggItem/EnderpearlItem/WindChargeItem.use). That the request reached the server guard is shown only indirectly, by the server's inventory resync packets after act in every locked row. Consistent and sufficient, but a server_reach-style oracle (as for vehicles/villagers) would make it direct.
The state probe reports the tested ability as null, so the plugin's own lock state is not visible in the excerpts; the lock is inferred from count < threshold, the overlay and the absent effect.
